purpose: Specifies state models and permitted transitions for ToC publication, build execution, and DLID embedding, as the normative transition tables that scripts enforce.
summary: Separation of ToC publication state from build progress; rebuild-needed and reference-absent are results, not states
Transition tables are normative; disallowed combinations are rejected and no new confirmed ToC is created
Confirmed ToC states: unbuilt or published, with transitions P-01 to P-03
Build execution states and transitions B-01 to B-09 from start through completion or failure
AI generation requests are allowed only after changes are fixed
Failure keeps the old confirmed ToC and already confirmed document info is not rolled back
Reference check results: match, path mismatch, or absent in directory, with checked directory and time
State transition tests are defined in DES-009
DLID embedding execution states and transitions E-01 to E-07 including duplicate original confirmation
Search, DLID resolution, and checks hold no state
tasks: Implementing state transition guards in scripts
Designing build failure and retry behavior
title: DES-004 状態モデルと許可遷移
